visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with auburn hair in a ponytail, wearing a white t-shirt and white skirt, stands inside a brightly lit stationery store. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial gestures, then turns to a female employee in a green apron. They discuss a watercolor paint set. (2) The scene transitions to the woman talking with a second female employee with short light brown hair. They hold a pen. A close-up shot follows, showing a hand with manicured nails using the black pen to write 'Teacher Chiang' in elegant English calligraphy on white paper. (3) The woman interviews a third female employee wearing a face mask. They stand in front of shelves stocked with Traveler's Notebooks. A close-up shows several varieties of the notebooks, followed by a shot of a smartphone screen displaying a decorated journal page. (4) The woman is now with a fourth female employee wearing glasses. They discuss a yellow storage bag with cartoon illustrations. A stylized product shot shows the bag on a wooden table next to an open book, a cup of tea, and dried orange slices. (5) Finally, the woman speaks with a male employee wearing a colorful geometric pattern shirt and glasses. He demonstrates a 'Pochitto' stamp device. A close-up shows his finger pressing the button to stamp a tiny red rabbit onto paper. The woman reacts with intense excitement, holding the product and smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-energy female voice questioning if stationery shop employees are all 'stationery enthusiasts.' A bright, medium-tempo pop BGM with a steady electronic beat plays in the background. (2) A second female voice introduces a watercolor set with a friendly, informative tone. The BGM remains consistent. (3) A third female voice recommends a specific pen, speaking clearly with slight rising intonations. A faint scratching sound of the pen on paper is audible. (4) The audio transitions to a fourth female voice describing notebooks. The host's voice returns periodically with high-pitched reactions. (5) A fifth female voice introduces a storage bag, followed by a comedic 'bubble' sound effect as she laughs. (6) A male voice explains a stamp product. A distinct, sharp mechanical 'click' is heard as the stamp is pressed. The host lets out a long, high-pitched scream of excitement 'RRRRRRR' followed by enthusiastic closing remarks as the BGM fades slightly.
